name: 去马赛克伪影分析
description: 分析 color filter array demosaicing 伪影 to verify camera origin and detect synthetic images.
mechanism: Real camera images exhibit specific demosaicing 模式 from Bayer CFA interpolation. This method 分析 inter-channel 相关性 模式 at pixel level 以检测 不一致.
parameters: CFA 模式: RGGB, Interpolation: bilinear/AHD/VNG, Correlation window: 5×5, Analysis: cross-channel
source: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Demosaicing, ACM IHMMSec
useCase: Verifying camera sensor origin by checking CFA demosaicing traces图像中的

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Demosaicing, ACM IHMMSec

strengths:
• Strongly linked to physical sensor
• Difficult to forge convincingly
• Works 跨 camera brands
• 检测 both AI and spliced images
limitations:
• Not applicable to RAW images
• Some cameras use non-Bayer 模式
• Heavy post-processing may mask traces
• Requires sufficient spatial 分辨率
